title: LWM: Silence false positive stringop-overflow warning (take 2)

notes.body: enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for e14ef590e3b932f8b5edcd8464d9913f8f820701 succeeds

changes_data.diff:
@@ -253,6 +253,18 @@ extern "C" {
   #define DIAG_ON_CAST_AWAY_CONST
 #endif
 
+/*
+ * GCC-only. Some  compilers other than GCC also define __GNUC__.
+ * We don't want those.
+ */
+#if defined(__GNUC__) && !defined(__clang__)
+  #define DIAG_OFF_STRINGOP_OVERFLOW() DIAG_OFF(stringop-overflow=)
+  #define DIAG_ON_STRINGOP_OVERFLOW() DIAG_ON(stringop-overflow=)
+#else
+  #define DIAG_OFF_STRINGOP_OVERFLOW()
+  #define DIAG_ON_STRINGOP_OVERFLOW()
+#endif
+
